title: Sweet Potato, Spinach and Goat's Cheese Pastry Plait
subtitle: in golden puff pastry
description: A braided puff pastry loaf filled with roasted sweet potato cubes, fresh spinach and melting goat's cheese. The plaiting looks harder than it is.

steps.text: Make the filling: heat a large pan, add oil and fry the 1 cm sweet potato cubes for about 5 minutes until golden. Season with salt and pepper, turn off the heat and cool for 10 minutes.
Add the spinach and the 1 cm cubes of goat's cheese and mix.

Roll the pastry out on a floured surface to a 40x25 cm rectangle. Lightly mark two lengthways lines with a knife (without cutting through), dividing it into 3 narrow rectangles. Cut the two outer rectangles into diagonal strips about 1.5 cm wide. Remove the top and bottom strip on each side.

Place the filling along the middle rectangle and fold the top and bottom tabs of pastry over it. Fold the right and left strips over in a plait until finished. Beat the egg yolk with the teaspoon of water and brush over the pastry.
Bake for about 30 minutes until the pastry is browned.
